assumptions.choice: The order quantity is position_usdt divided by the signal bar close.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires a fixed USDT-equivalent position; the signal bar close is the available price when the entry condition is evaluated.

assumptions.choice: Take-profit and stop-loss OCO sell orders are submitted after the market entry completes, using its executed price.
assumptions.reason: This makes the stated percentages apply exactly from the actual entry price.

assumptions.choice: mode is exposed as a configurable parameter but does not change signal or order logic.
assumptions.reason: The harness provides only simulated Backtrader execution and no distinct real-trading broker interface.
